|strategy=By [mailto:briank@decipher.com Brian Kallenbach]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/sealeddeck/small/tatooinetuskancanyon.html</ref>

Expanding on the already-sprawling planet of [[Tatooine (Dark){{!}}Tatooine]], Tusken Canyon helps a Sealed Deck game in a number of ways, as well as opening up interesting options in standard Swiss play.

First, in Sealed Deck, the [[Gaderffii Stick]] is now a card to be reckoned with, giving a drain of three at a site. It also expands on the capabilities of Tusken Raiders in Sealed Deck.

In a non-Sealed Deck game, this site provides an additional Force drain location, while not giving your opponent too much Force. Combined with a Trooper strategy, Tusken Raiders can be fearsome, giving an immense amount of power in 4 characters. Add in a few Gaderffii Sticks to increase this site's Force drain and make this group even deadlier.

Combo:

[[Tatooine: Tusken Canyon]] + Tusken Raiders + Gaderffii Sticks + [[Darth Vader]] + [[Vader's Lightsaber]] - This is a powerful combination. With four Raiders plus [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]], you have 16 power and a destiny draw, as well as a swipe with the Lightsaber. If your opponent threatens to kill [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] or one of the Raiders, simply knock away his weapon as quickly as possible. Add in Snipers to take care of [[Undercover (Dark){{!}}Undercover]] spies, and you have a fairly stable Force drain.
